_doc: Outside hosts that inherited files may NAME without any executable request reaching them. tools/design/credentials.mjs fails on any host not listed here. A host on this list is still blocked at runtime by the worker and the runners.

hosts.demo.photonpulse.ai: qa/contract.json and production docs: the demo app, kept for byte identity of the shared contract; never read in mock mode
hosts.demo-api.photonpulse.ai: production docs and the sanitised instruction copies; the design vercel.json carries no rewrite to it
hosts.api-pulse.photonlegal.com: src/lib/appConfig.ts fallback for one legacy download; intercepted by the worker
hosts.photonlegal.com: index.html OpenGraph image metadata, not fetched by the browser
hosts.us.posthog.com: src/App.tsx analytics ui_host, inert while the env gate is off
hosts.fonts.googleapis.com: production index.html; the design build strips the link and serves vendored faces
hosts.fonts.gstatic.com: production index.html preconnect; stripped by the design build
hosts.accounts.google.com: the Google client the design build replaces with an inert shim; also production CSP docs
hosts.www.googleapis.com: src/pages/auth Google user-info call, unreachable with the shim
hosts.cdn.tailwindcss.com: design/v4/PL-TKN-004.html, the approved token specification kept as a byte-exact reference; never served or executed by the product
hosts.scripts.sil.org: the SIL Open Font License texts under public/fonts name their home page; documentation only, never fetched
